description: Encode or decode text as base64, base64url, hex, URL (percent) encoding, HTML entities, punycode (domain names) or quoted-printable. Body { input, scheme, direction }, up to 1 MB. Invalid input to decode is a 400 that names the position of the first bad character. Unknown HTML entities are reported, not guessed. Pure code, no outside request. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

input.description: The text to encode or decode (JSON body field)

scheme.description: base64, base64url, hex, url, html, punycode or quoted-printable

name: encode
title: Encode
